Text cut to the law's conclusion; to_law and drops kept (invariant fails immediately once a move does not keep R).

to.en: the sub-process keeping P s (the steps after which s can still be had) keeps s: from wherever its course from s leads it can have s again (Keeps (keeping P s) s)

to.en: from a start level up to hi, the condition ends (its level is 0 at some step) exactly where the start is below H + y: from H + y up to hi it never ends

corrections.why: ends_iff_below concludes only an iff on the level reaching 0; 'never falls below its start and never exceeds hi' is RegimeMargin.holds's conclusion (the entry's edge text joins the two). Text cut to ends_iff_below's conclusion.
